policy.KEEP: Compatible implementation retained behind the v0.3 ownership boundary.
policy.ADAPT: Reuse implementation or behaviour while changing callers, ownership or protocol.
policy.REPLACE: Implement the required missing owner or retire an incompatible live responsibility after cutover.
policy.RETIRE: Remove from production use only after callers are disconnected and regressions pass; not permission to delete during audit.

ownership_transition.present_owner: WorldFlow writes Adventure.state.world_node and calls DmbWorldSim.advance_turn on different-node enter
ownership_transition.target_owner_boundary: Python WorldState + Travel/Wait commands through WorldClient
ownership_transition.regression_or_difference: Intentional v0.3 difference: only accepted Travel and distinct Wait advance exactly one turn.
ownership_transition.disconnect_evidence: G01 tests instrument old advance_turn/save paths and prove they cannot run in migrated production runtime.

ownership_transition.target_owner_boundary: Python faction registry; internal commands use faction authority context
ownership_transition.regression_or_difference: Preserve compatible deterministic outcomes; v0.3 staged TurnRunner and identity rules replace ad-hoc order.
ownership_transition.disconnect_task: T009-T013 core, T039-T047 behaviour, production cutover T017-T024
ownership_transition.disconnect_evidence: No production call path to GDScript faction mutation; Python replay/checks own authoritative results.

ownership_transition.present_owner: DmbCatanState and DmbCarts serialized by DmbWorldSim
ownership_transition.target_owner_boundary: Python Catan/construction/logistics services via typed commands and receipts
ownership_transition.regression_or_difference: Preserve conservation/one-edge semantics; keep Catan cargo separate from future Game-Time industry.
ownership_transition.disconnect_evidence: Normal and fixture projections read Python views; GDScript Catan/cart mutators unreachable in production.

ownership_transition.present_owner: Workers are derived projection dictionaries; fixture NPC IDs/flags live in Adventure and fixture runner
ownership_transition.target_owner_boundary: Python Person/Building registries and quest service; Godot receives semantic projections
ownership_transition.regression_or_difference: Intentional v0.3 difference: stable persistent identities survive saves and eras; animation remains non-authoritative.
ownership_transition.disconnect_evidence: Repeated projection/save/era tests retain IDs and no client path creates durable people/buildings.

ownership_transition.present_owner: DmbQuests applies effects to GDScript world while VillageQuestRunner separately mutates fixture/Adventure flags
ownership_transition.target_owner_boundary: Single Python QuestService + typed condition/effect dispatcher
ownership_transition.regression_or_difference: Converge both paths; preserve compatible branches/content and exactly-once outcomes.
ownership_transition.disconnect_evidence: Normal and village fixtures invoke the same Python commands; competing runner cannot mutate production state.

ownership_transition.present_owner: Adventure.pending_battle/last_battle_result plus Godot BattleSim; result immediately saves client state

ownership_transition.regression_or_difference: Preserve tested duel mechanics; checkpoint and result retransmission must apply persistent consequence once.
ownership_transition.disconnect_evidence: Lease version/hash and duplicate-result tests; no direct Adventure durable outcome write.

ownership_transition.present_owner: Adventure.save writes user://adventure.save v4 including serialized DmbWorldSim

ownership_transition.disconnect_task: T014 core and T019 production coordination
ownership_transition.disconnect_evidence: G01 save/exit/relaunch/load continuity and instrumentation proving old campaign world-save writer cannot run.
